title: Resolution on the democratic backsliding and threats to political pluralism in Georgia
part_text: ‘Deplores the personal role played by Georgia’s oligarch Bidzina Ivanishvili, who returned to active politics on 30 December 2023 when he became “honorary chairman” of the Georgian Dream party, in the current political crisis and in yet another attempt to undermine the Euro-Atlantic orientation of the country in favour of pivoting towards Russia;’
